changeSet.author: core-foundation
core-foundation
changeSet.sql:
CREATE POLICY users_select_own ON users FOR SELECT USING (id = auth.uid());
CREATE POLICY users_update_own ON users FOR UPDATE USING (id = auth.uid()) WITH CHECK (id = auth.uid());
changeSet.rollback: DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_select_own ON users; DROP POLICY IF EXISTS users_update_own ON users;
